content.text:
I sorted all 198 entries by month and category. August was by far your biggest month, and dining is the budget that got away from you.

## Spending by category and month

| Category | June | July | August | Quarter total |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Shopping | $1,020.77 | $756.72 | $1,218.31 | $2,995.80 |
| Groceries (incl. Costco) | $624.34 | $883.32 | $982.79 | $2,490.45 |
| Travel (Delta, Marriott, Hertz, airport parking) | – | – | $1,631.82 | $1,631.82 |
| Subscriptions and bills | $313.98 | $331.39 | $252.77 | $898.14 |
| Gas | $133.63 | $274.59 | $426.99 | $835.21 |
| Dining and coffee | $212.74 | $165.14 | $398.69 | $776.57 |
| Transfers and cash (Zelle, Venmo, PayPal, ATM) | $271.20 | $105.79 | $269.74 | $646.73 |
| Health | $276.43 | $138.36 | $168.61 | $583.40 |
| Rideshare and city parking | $327.78 | $99.08 | $135.59 | $562.45 |
| Entertainment | $95.84 | $135.51 | $160.88 | $392.23 |
| **Total** | **$3,276.71** | **$2,889.90** | **$5,646.19** | **$11,812.80** |

## Budget comparison

| | Budget | June | July | August | Monthly average |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Dining and coffee | $260 | $212.74 (under) | $165.14 (under) | **$398.69 (+$138.69, 53% over)** | $258.86 |
| Shopping | $1,200 | $1,020.77 (under) | $756.72 (under) | **$1,218.31 (+$18.31, 1.5% over)** | $998.60 |

- **Dining:** Your notes say it's been creeping up, but the data shows something different. It fell from June to July, then jumped in August. The average of $258.86 looks like it's right on budget, but that hides the spike.
- **Dining frequency:** The number of dining charges went from 10 to 9 to 18. Average charge size stayed around $21–22, so you ate out about twice as often in August.
- **Shopping:** It's well clear of your $2,000 worry. The $1,200 budget was only just exceeded in August. July looks low partly because of a $68 REI return.
- **Biggest category:** Shopping is your largest category over the quarter. In August it was second to the trip.

## Month-to-month changes

| Change | June → July | July → August |
|---|---|---|
| Total spending | −$386.81 (−12%) | +$2,756.29 (+95%) |
| Total excluding the trip | – | $2,889.90 → $4,014.37 (+39%) |
| Gas | +$140.96 | +$152.40 |
| Groceries | +$258.98 | +$99.47 |
| Dining | −$47.60 | +$233.55 |
| Shopping | −$264.05 | +$461.59 |

## The three most important things

1. **August was a very large month, and it's not only the trip.** The Delta, Marriott, Hertz and airport parking charges came to $1,631.82. Even without them, August was $4,014, about 39% above July, because dining, shopping and gas all rose together.
2. **Dining isn't creeping, it spiked.** August was $138.69 over your $260 target because you ate out twice as often, not because meals got pricier. Part of that may be trip-related, so September will show whether it was a one-off.
3. **Gas and groceries are rising steadily, with no budget on them.** Gas went $134 → $275 → $427, which is more than tripled in three months, and groceries went $624 → $883 → $983. These are the real creep in your spending. Each is now larger than your dining category.

## Things in the data you should check

- **Two Delta charges** on Aug 14, $412.60 and $450.60. If one is a duplicate or a replaced booking, August drops by up to $450.60.
- **Trader Joe's on Jul 22** appears twice at $54.12. If it's a duplicate, July groceries are $829.20.
- **$646.73 in transfers and cash** (Zelle, Venmo, PayPal, ATM) has no merchant attached, so I couldn't categorize it.
- **Category choices I made:**
  - Costco is in groceries. If you buy household goods there, some of it is really shopping.
  - Amazon Prime is in subscriptions, not shopping.
  - Steam is in subscriptions, though it could count as entertainment.
  - Some dates in your log are out of order, so I assigned each entry to the month in its own date.

I did the sorting and totaling with a script, so the arithmetic is exact. The category labels are my judgment calls.
